about.title: About
paragraphs: I am a software developer with a Biomedical Engineering background, enterprise web experience, and hands-on hospital software exposure. My professional work has included Angular/TypeScript frontend systems, Java/JavaScript full-stack tasks, database-backed features, and production bug fixing.

Recently, my focus has shifted toward AI-assisted product development: local-first apps, RAG, OCR, document workflows, controlled AI interaction loops, decision-support interfaces, and MVPs that can be explained clearly instead of just demoed visually.

During my transition to Germany, I have been improving my German, aligning with the local software job market, and building focused portfolio products around practical problems. I still like games, systems, and tools with a bit of personality, but the center of gravity is useful software.

productThinking.title: Product Thinking
items: I model vague real-world problems into explicit data structures, rules, and review flows.
I constrain AI instead of letting it hallucinate.
I separate source retrieval, user data, AI explanation, local scoring rules, and final user decision.
I prefer local-first and BYOK patterns when user documents are sensitive.
I build MVPs that are demoable, deployable, and explainable.

projects.title: Schleimer
projects.description: Controlled AI dialogue game where the player tries to survive a sarcastic job interview by balancing Hire Chance, Boss Patience, and Schleim Level. The LLM only writes boss dialogue; scoring, endings, hidden skill tags, and game state are handled by a deterministic local engine.
designed: Mock-first architecture with optional AI dialogue
